narrative: Paul - He is back. Most of the story is above but I can come up with some more. The league was getting a little dry with some of the owners that had been brought aboard. They were good owners, just didn't post much and the drama that had made the league interesting was fading. Welcome back, Paul! And the trash talker is back. Our drink was getting stale and needed the straw back. Back to rebuild too. 1st season back was a 4-15 season and has improved its win count each year. In 4 years the team is back in the Playoffs. 1st year back and another Toilet Bowl which is now the JaMarcus Russell Bowl and still no trophy. If anyone is counting, that's 4 appearances in the JaMarcus Russell Bowl. Its a lot but not the most. Paul has picked up a Defensive Rookie Award with Kwon Alexander in Season 10. If we could get some more drunkin' trades now. Lol. Paul has calmed down a bit. Must be the Indica. He did win the Cathedral Bowl in Season 19. He has also moved to 4th in total wins.
